checks.summary: The fixed loopback listener, private per-run runtime identity, public non-sensitive health state, and clean stop are specific, bounded, and testable.
The live capability contract maps directly to the existing browser-discovered dresser-preset/v1 object and exact mirror integrity anchor.
The valid PNG and preset path can reuse BrowserSessionManager's genuine Dresser browser download, validated PNG metadata, unique output, and bounded artifact contract.
Authentication, Host, CORS, method, route, media, body, PNG, and preset failures are enumerated and must be rejected before browser mutation with stable redacted errors.
Deterministic BUSY behavior and exact owned Chrome, mirror, temporary-file, output, listener, and runtime cleanup are observable across success, failure, disconnect, timeout, shutdown, and restart.
The packet explicitly forbids sensitive request, token, path, preset, CDP, and stack data in logs, errors, or evidence and freezes a direct leakage check.
The mirror, MCP contracts, live render, timeout cleanup, and interactive Dresser are protected by explicit exclusions and frozen regression gates.
The task owns the bridge test directory and package script needed to define the frozen test command during implementation.
The task owns the bridge files and package script needed for a bounded ESLint gate without touching unrelated portfolio code.
The task owns the bridge modules and package script needed for the frozen syntax/build gate.
Fresh baseline execution passed all 10 MCP tests, including real browser export, timeout cleanup, capability discovery, and BUSY overlap.
Fresh task-scoped MCP lint completed with exit 0.
Fresh MCP syntax and schema build completed with exit 0.
Fresh SHA-256 verification passed every exact mirror manifest entry.
The frozen demo is reproducible against the exact local listener and distinguishes Dresser's browser download from screenshots or arbitrary output paths.
The negative matrix is concrete across token, Host, opaque-origin CORS, method, path, content type, preset, body framing, size, timing, overlap, and disconnect boundaries.
The check records only task-owned paths and PIDs and verifies cleanup without deleting pre-existing MCP artifacts or unrelated processes.
The frozen review covers scoped diff, exact two-tool MCP contract, browser success and timeout, mirror manifest, interactive route, and preservation of plugin UI, portfolio, and dirty worktree.
Ownership is bounded to the new bridge, tests, and package scripts; the dependent plugin is sequential, and mirror, MCP, UI, deployment, generated assets, and unrelated dirty work are excluded.
The local API risk is bounded by fixed routes and origin, closed input contracts, stable redacted errors, body limits, and direct protocol tests.
The Chrome and mirror integration is exact, loopback-only, timeout-bounded, serialized, and protected by live regression and owned-process cleanup checks.
Ephemeral authentication, private ignored runtime state, bounded PNG-only input, redaction, loopback transport, and bridge-owned cleanup define a reproducible privacy boundary.
